concepts.gloss_en: The Name of the Holy One (God's name; here equated with Torah and the midot)
The wrath of the Holy One (God's anger, per 'the king's wrath')
The prayer of the Holy One (God's prayer / simple mercies)
The Holy One, blessed be He (God Himself, not a possessed attribute)

members.note: the divine name itself; not a construct on an attribute

notes: Rule 4: each form has a different construct/possessed head (name vs. wrath vs. prayer), and the bare form names God Himself. All four are distinct concepts; token-overlap on 'הקדוש ברוך הוא' is not identity.
